This development is a clear sign that we are right to trust the guidance of our supreme leader, [From.GetRulerTitle] [From.GetRulerName].

texts.zh:
人们已经准备好抛弃自己的物质形态，投身数字意识。他们愿意在完全虚拟的环境中继续生存。

通过这样的协议褫夺他们的感知，我们就能完全自由地操纵他们的现实，增强他们对国家的正面情感。与伟大领袖一条心的人民是强大国家的基石。
texts.en:
The people are ready to cast off their physical forms in favor of a digital consciousness. They are willing to continue their existence in a fully virtual environment.

Having thus signed away their perception, we have complete freedom to manipulate their reality, enhancing positive sentiments toward the state. A population aligned with their leadership is the pillar of a strong nation.

texts.zh:
[root.GetSpeciesAdj]们仍未决定意识的数字化应该采取何种形式。保守派希望我们深深扎根于躯体，而其他人则讨厌这种新旧之间的“折衷”。

我们必须做出一个选择。或是关注身躯让单个劳工控制多个身体，或是关注虚拟存在让对社会控制达到前所未有的高度。
texts.en:
The [root.GetSpeciesAdj] population remains undecided on what form our digitized consciousness should take. More conservative voices would have us remain deeply rooted in corporeal bodies, while others resent this "half measure" between old and new.

It falls upon us to make that choice. The physical focus would allow a single worker to control multiple bodies, while a virtual existence would enable societal control on an unprecedented scale.

# 合成化社会 / Synthesized Society

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/machine_age_situation_events_2.txt:2644-2738

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “合成冲击”事件链的终点：机会事件结束后180+随机90天，隐藏事件 synth.1500 按政体权威分发：民主 1505、寡头 1510、独裁 1515、帝制 1520、企业 1525。
  End of the "Synth Shock" chain: 180 days (+ random 90) after the opportunity event hidden synth.1500 switches on has_authority: democratic 1505, oligarchic 1510, dictatorial 1515, imperial 1520, corporate 1525.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「独裁政体」的最终事件：国家选择实体化（synth_physical）或虚拟化（synth_virtual）的合成体取向并设置国家标志，虚拟化选项还会触发 cybernetics.5046；另有一个保留现状的选项。
  The final event for dictatorial governments: the country picks a physical (synth_physical) or virtual (synth_virtual) synthetic orientation and the matching country flag is set; the virtual option also fires cybernetics.5046; a third option keeps the status quo.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 故事终点；五个政体版本互斥（由 has_authority 决定）。
  The end of the chain; the five authority versions are exclusive (by has_authority).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 仅出现给独裁权威的国家。
  Shown only to dictatorial (authority auth_dictatorial) countries.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 说明：这十个最终事件（cyber/synth 1505–1525）不在任何审阅者的分配列表中，作为连带内容一并审阅。
  Note: these ten final events (cyber/synth 1505-1525) are in no reviewer's assignment list and were reviewed as part of the same chains.
- 已核对：触发条件、选项效果；编译树与脚本一致。
  Checked: trigger conditions and option effects; the compiled tree matches the script.
